definitions.explanation: The third day of the week in the Japanese calendar (which starts on Sunday). Short form of {火曜日|かようび}. Used in scheduling, calendars, and everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {火曜|かよう}は{休|やす}みです。
{会議|かいぎ}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{火曜|かよう}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The meeting is held every Tuesday.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{火曜|かよう}までにレポートを{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the report by next Tuesday.

notes:
USAGE:
Short form of {火曜日|かようび}. Both are common; {火曜|かよう} is slightly more concise and often seen in written schedules. The name comes from {火星|かせい} (Mars), following the East Asian system of naming days after celestial bodies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毎週|まいしゅう}{火曜|かよう}: every Tuesday
- {火曜|かよう}の{夜|よる}: Tuesday night
- {来週|らいしゅう}の{火曜|かよう}: next Tuesday
- {火曜|かよう}と{木曜|もくよう}: Tuesday and Thursday
